description: Tusab inside your AI: extract YouTube channels on this computer and query the base with citations to the exact minute.
long_description: Tusab extracts transcripts from YouTube channels, playlists and videos on this computer, from your own IP, and organizes everything in a local folder (the same structure as Tusab desktop). Your AI tool queries this base and cites the video and the minute. The Tusab screen opens in the browser, served by this computer. Nothing goes through CriAugu servers: only the excerpts the AI queries go to the AI you chose.

tools.name: tusab_buscar
tools.description: Searches the local base and returns excerpts with source, minute and link.

tools.name: tusab_listar_projetos
tools.description: Lists the projects, with sources, excerpts and extraction coverage.

tools.name: tusab_ler_fonte
tools.description: Reads a source in order, starting from a given minute.

tools.name: tusab_ler_original
tools.description: Opens the original file of a document (an image, or pages of a PDF) when the text is not enough.

tools.name: tusab_adicionar_youtube
tools.description: Extracts a channel, playlist or video on this computer and indexes it.

tools.name: tusab_adicionar_arquivo
tools.description: Adds a .txt or .md file to the project texts.

tools.name: tusab_fontes_publicas

tools.name: tusab_buscar_fonte_publica

tools.name: tusab_salvar_estudo
tools.description: Saves flashcards, sticky notes or a summary created by the AI, to review in other conversations.

tools.name: tusab_revisao_hoje

tools.name: tusab_registrar_revisao
tools.description: Records the grade of a reviewed flashcard.

tools.name: tusab_novidades_semana
tools.description: Lists what was added to the project in the last 7 days.

tools.name: tusab_economia
tools.description: Shows how many tokens Tusab saved the AI (excerpts only × whole sources). Local estimate.

tools.name: tusab_status

tools.name: tusab_abrir_painel
tools.description: Opens the Tusab screen in the browser, served by this computer.
